description: This file contains tests for MCP (possibly a custom application or component) using Playwright testing framework. It defines parameterized tests to verify browser behavior under different configurations, including headless mode and browser types like Chrome, Edge, and Chromium. The tests involve setting up server routes, navigating to a URL, and checking the user agent string.

methods.name: test.describe
methods.description: Defines a group of related tests with a descriptive name.

methods.name: test.use
methods.description: Sets test-specific options or fixtures for the subsequent tests.

methods.name: test.skip
methods.description: Skips a test under certain conditions, optionally with a message.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines an individual test case with a description and test function.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertion library used to verify test outcomes.

methods.name: server.setRoute
methods.description: Sets up a server route to respond with specific content.

methods.name: client.callTool
methods.description: Executes a client tool with specified parameters and retrieves the response.
